sb.dtl:
Routes  6, 25, 26, 28, & 67 will be detoured for all University of Michigan home football games.  Detours start 3 hours prior to kickoff and detours end 1 hour after the game ends.  Other routes may also experience delays due to traffic before and after each game, please plan ahead accordingly.  This years home games are scheduled on Sept. 5,12 & 19, Oct. 17 & 24 and Nov. 7 & 21.


For more information, please call Route Info at 734-996-0400.

sb.dtl: Starting Sunday, May 3, the Blake Transit Center will be temporarily closed for the DDA's 4th Ave. construction project. All bus stops will be moved to 5th Ave. & Washington St. Call 734-996-0400 for route information. Stay Up To Date
sb.brf: 4th Ave/BTC temporary closure starts May 3. All bus stops will be moved to 5th Ave. & Washington St.

sb.dtl:
Starting Monday, August 31, Rt 22 to the BTC will be detoured due to the construction closure of northbound Nixon.

Rt 22 to TBTC:  From Traver & Nixon, right on Nixon, veer left in roundabout onto Huron parkway, left Plymouth Rd, left Green Rd, continue on DuVarren to resume regular route.

Bus stops located on northbound Nixon between Traver & Green will be out of service.  Nearest bus stops will be located on Traver, Plymouth Mall, or DhuVarren Rd.

For more information, please call Route Info at 734-996-0400.
sb.brf: [SERVICE ALERT] Starting Mon., Aug. 31, Rt 22 will be detoured due to construction.  More info at TheRide.org
